title: Psychomotor sexological therapy
blurb: We work with both conversation and body. Psychomotor therapy unites cognition and sensation — a natural path to sexual wellbeing.
body:
## The meeting

You're allowed to be in the room before you have to explain yourself. We begin by arriving and listening to what's present in you — without it having to lead anywhere in particular. 

### When words aren't _enough_

Sometimes we stay with conversation. Other times we work with movement, breath, and self-touch, always within what you bring into the space. That's often where something long held opens and transforms.

### In your own _order_

A course of sessions might be about desire, boundaries, relationships, or the body — rarely in a fixed sequence. You don't need to know exactly what you're bringing; we find the direction as we go.
